scripts.dev:platform: pnpm run generate:api && pnpm --filter @saas-forge/platform-console run dev
scripts.dev:tenant: pnpm run generate:api && pnpm --filter @saas-forge/tenant-console-shell run dev
scripts.test:browser:current: pnpm --filter @saas-forge/design-system run test:browser && pnpm run test:browser:consumers && pnpm run test:browser:sessions
scripts.test:browser:compatibility: pnpm run test:browser:chrome && pnpm run test:browser:edge && pnpm run test:browser:firefox && pnpm run test:browser:webkit
scripts.test:browser:chrome: SF_BROWSER=chromium SF_BROWSER_CHANNEL=chrome SF_VISUAL_SNAPSHOTS=false pnpm run test:browser:current
scripts.test:browser:edge: SF_BROWSER=chromium SF_BROWSER_CHANNEL=msedge SF_VISUAL_SNAPSHOTS=false pnpm run test:browser:current
scripts.test: pnpm run test:boundaries && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test
scripts.build: pnpm run generate:api && pnpm run build:workspace
scripts.verify:workspace: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:browser:chromium && pnpm run build:workspace
scripts.verify: pnpm run generate:api && pnpm run verify:workspace
